subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should this PR's `sessions.activity` RPC/event and task/tool plugin hooks become the public activity contract, or should they be deferred behind the canonical Gateway activity issue?
rationale: The patch defines new Gateway protocol and plugin SDK surfaces whose semantics overlap an open maintainer-owned activity/attention contract; code review cannot safely choose that permanent API direction.

options.title: Align With Canonical Contract
options.body: Fix the scoping bug, resolve conflicts, and reshape or defer the RPC/event/hooks until they match the maintainer-approved activity and attention semantics.

options.title: Accept This API Deliberately
options.body: Maintainers can approve this smaller activity snapshot and hook set as the first public contract, accepting that follow-up work will extend or revise the broader issue.

options.title: Pause Behind Existing Issues
options.body: Leave or close this branch as a source attempt while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 and the current Tasks page/status work define the durable path.

recommendation.title: Align With Canonical Contract
recommendation.body: Fix the scoping bug, resolve conflicts, and reshape or defer the RPC/event/hooks until they match the maintainer-approved activity and attention semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the canonical activity-contract issue and has adjacent plugin API history.
